messages:
Jules: Quick sync — we need to finalize launch acceptance for the Q3 tenant-burst pilot. Product is asking for a clear SLA + rollback gates so sales can commit.

Aisha: For context — customer asked for 99.9% availability and p95 latency <= 150ms for text gen for premium tenants. They also want HSM-backed keying and audit retention in the private pilot.

Devin: 150ms p95 is tight depending on model & prompt length. We can hit it if we: 
- limit model to gpt-like small-medium variant (quantized), 
- enforce max tokens 512 for the pilot, and
- enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts.

Sanjay: Capacity note: Dedicated pools are nearly full in the EU region the week of the proposed launch. We need a 2-week allocation window to reserve burst GPUs or we can route to US but that impacts latency SLA.

Riley: Security checklist flags: HSM/KMS integration + SOC audit logs needed before any private pilot. That typically adds ~3 weeks for cert and config. Also need clear data residency for audit logs.

Jules: Ok. Proposal (quick):
1) Acceptance criteria for pilot (must pass):
   - p95 text-gen latency <= 200ms (soft target 150ms)
   - 99.9% availability (measured by infra alerts)
   - HSM/KMS in place and audit logs retained 90 days
   - Canary traffic at 1% -> 10% -> 100% with rollback on 5% error spike
2) If runtime can't hit 150ms, we ship with 200ms + explicit note to customer.
3) Infra provides GPU reservation + fallback region by T-14 days.

Aisha: I can accept 200ms as a negotiated SLA for pilot if we commit to a Q4 perf uplift plan. That keeps sales moving.

Devin: For the rollout plan I suggest:
- Step 0: model variant locked + quant config (Dev runtime)
- Step 1: canary with prefix cache on (1%)
- Step 2: enable batching policy with max batch latency 20ms
- Fallback: route to cheaper model if load spikes > 2x baseline and autoscale can't keep up

Sanjay: I'll own the T-14 capacity reservation. If ops approves, I need the exact GPU SKU and region by EOD Friday. Also we need to decide whether we prewarm GPUs or rely on burst (prewarm preferred).

Riley: I'll start the HSM procurement thread and loop legal. FYI: HSM + SOC config will require a small infra change to secrets provisioning — tag me on the PR.

Jules: Next actions / owners:
- Aisha: confirm customer ok with 200ms pilot SLA + Q4 perf plan (by Thu)
- Devin: lock model variant & batching config, add canary route (by Mon)
- Sanjay: reserve GPUs + prewarm plan (T-14) (by EOD Fri)
- Riley: start HSM + audit log work and PR template (by Tue)

Devin: One more runtime nit — we should add an automated fallback policy in the router config (pseudo):
```json
{"route_policy": "preferred: quant-model-a, fallback: quant-model-b, circuit_breaker: 5%_err_rate"}
```
That way product SLAs are explicit and we can auto-roll back.

Aisha: Sounds good. If everyone signs up to these owners, I'll tell sales to proceed with the pilot commitment.

Sanjay: ack from infra side. Will post reservation ticket in infra-board and attach GPU SKU.

Riley: ack from security — starting procurement.

ops-bot: deployment-scheduler created ticket INFRA-7722 with ETA 2026-05-06 for prewarm reservation.

Jules: Thanks all. If no blockers, we'll run this as the canonical launch acceptance. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

Aisha: ack :thumbsup:

Devin: ack, will post PR with configs.

Sanjay: will follow up in infra-board.

Riley: looping legal now.
